description: ADO-BATCH generated key: on a client static batch-optimistic Recordset of SELECT ID, Code, L, S FROM T ORDER BY ID (read/write copy) stage AddNew Code "n9", S of row 1, Delete of row 2 and AddNew Code "n10"; read each row's Status and ID (the new rows' ID values); read the Update Resync property; UpdateBatch(adAffectAll) and the Errors; read each row's Status and ID again, then Requery and read ID and Code; then the stored rows through Execute. Asks when and whether the generated AutoNumber values reach the cached rows, and the order the file received the changes.
retentionNote: Designed r-ado-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
